Name: Soffy's Better Male Flower Dance Outfits
Author: Nekotekina
Description:
Improves the bachelors' Flower Dance outfits to make them more appropriate, with less saturated color, while also improving the weird leg sprites.

[b]Special note:[/b] 90% of users who download my mods forget to endorse them. If you like this mod, consider endorsing it! It shows appreciation for our efforts and greatly helps me by allowing more people to see it.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/WzQQc1T/ENDORSE.gif[/img]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png[/img]
1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher;
2. Download this mod & extract [CP] Better Male Flower Dance Outfits folder to Stardew Valley/Mods;
3. Run the game with SMAPI to play.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png[/img]
Should be compatible with most mods, unless they target the same sprites.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/ccJ4SPZ.png[/img]
